title: Rebellion of Túpac Amaru II (1780–1781)
summary: On 4 November 1780 José Gabriel Condorcanqui, a cacique claiming descent from the last Inca and taking the name Túpac Amaru, seized Tinta's corregidor Antonio de Arriaga, starting a major Andean revolt against Spanish colonial rule. He was executed in Cuzco on 18 May 1781, though the wider rebellion lasted until about 1783.

uncertainty.note: Start is 4 November 1780 (seizure of Arriaga). End is the 18 May 1781 execution of Túpac Amaru; the Great Andean Rebellion continued in the south to 1783 (Encyclopedia.com).
